title: Crumple
description: Paper toss, the office classic, in 3D. A crumpled sheet sits on your desk and a wastepaper bin waits across the room: flick up to throw, flick faster to throw further, angle the flick to aim, and read the yellow arrow, because a desk fan is blowing and the number next to it is how hard. Five sheets a level, three in the bin to clear it, and the bin backs off a little further every time, from an open-plan office down to a basement and on to a bowling-alley bar. Endless mode counts a streak until you miss. Baskets pay cash for new paper and bins in the shop. Real physics: the bin is a cone with a lip, so rim shots rattle in or spin out, and a paper ball flops instead of rolling.
